prompt_en: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a wide editorial disaster photograph of a visible irreversible threshold crossing from inside a reentry capsule looking back through its circular docking collar toward a rupturing orbital habitat. One unmistakably adult woman, guided only by the reference's visible long center-parted dark wavy hair, dark brown eyes, softly arched brows, and broadly comparable face proportions, is halfway across a circular docking threshold into a reentry capsule. Keep the causal approach-crossing-consequence chain dominant. One identifiable subject object or process remains continuous from approach through crossing into the downstream state, realized as the single adult woman whose torso and two boots occupy one uninterrupted crossing pose. A concrete bridge hatch airlock edge line or boundary owns the one-way transition: the circular metal docking collar and its closing segmented pressure-door blades form the physical threshold. The subject intersects or has just cleared that threshold along one readable direction of travel, with her leading hand torso and boot inside the capsule and her trailing boot lifting over the sill. The route behind visibly closes collapses floods burns severs or is consumed so return is physically unavailable, as the pressure-door blades close and the flexible docking tunnel tears away along that same path. A concrete new condition or irreversible downstream process has already begun beyond the threshold, visible as Earth filling the capsule window and first orange reentry plasma streaking across its exterior. Use a low diagonal 28 mm viewpoint that keeps her face, full body, threshold, lost path, and destination legible together; cold practical cabin light separates her face from the warm plasma rim while retaining natural skin and metal texture in one instantaneous frame.
negative_en: body distortion, 3D render look, plastic-looking skin, excessive HDR, low resolution, cartoon style, fake-looking background

semantic_clarification_decisions.prompt_evidence: halfway across a circular docking threshold into a reentry capsule
semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: Preserves the frozen subject, event, reference-use boundary, and one-frame causal test without reinterpretation.
The subject is an orbital evacuee in this frame, and an aircraft service role would introduce a competing identity and procedure.

semantic_clarification_decisions.prompt_evidence: the route behind visibly closes collapses floods burns severs or is consumed so return is physically unavailable
semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: This is the arm's explicitly bound hard visual mechanism and governs the causal event.
A capture-medium failure would compete with physical decompression and make the lost return mechanism less inspectable.

decisions.rationale: A studio-shaped source would weaken the diegetic orbital emergency lighting.
The directional threshold axis is authored directly without adopting a portrait preset.
The crossing event already determines the necessary full-body geometry and must remain primary.
Exposure drag could blur the closing door and severed path required for native inspection.
Camera awareness would turn the causal crossing into a posed portrait.
A close crop cannot retain threshold, return-path failure, and downstream result together.
